)Excutive Order.
Miss Lillie Pratt, who was employed in the Government Printing
(office from September [9, [893, to May 27, 1907, when she was separated
On account Of reduction Of force, and wvho was injured in 1896, in the
course Of her eml1)loyI1lent and without negligoence on her part, may be
reinstated in that. office in a position of no higher grade than that from which
she was separated, without reference to the year limit of eligibility under
the reinstatement rule. The Pub~lic Printer states that the services of Miss
Pratt could be utilized to advantage, anad, in view of the facts in the case,
the Civil Service Commission concurs in recommending the order.
Wm H TAFT
/anuari' 20, 1910.
[No. 1 156.]
